VI.description: Reads the key state of the CALLING thread through user32.dll GetKeyboardState (stdcall\2C called in LabVIEW's UI thread): one byte per virtual-key code\2C bit 0x80 set while the key is down\2C bit 0x01 the toggle state. Windows keeps this state per thread and updates it only when the thread retrieves input from the real input queue - posted messages leave it alone. Running in the UI thread\2C this is the state LabVIEW's panels read for the modifier keys (GetKeyState). return value is the Win32 BOOL\3A non-zero on success\2C 0 on failure. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.

Indicator.description: 256 bytes\2C indexed by virtual-key code (0x10 VK_SHIFT\2C 0x11 VK_CONTROL\2C 0x12 VK_MENU ...). Bit 0x80 = down.
